edges.subject: neuronal ceroid lipofuscinoses
edges.quote: The neuronal ceroid lipofuscinoses (NCL) are a group of disorders defined by shared clinical and pathological features, including seizures and progressive decline in vision, neurocognition, and motor functioning, as well as accumulation of autofluorescent lysosomal storage material, or 'ceroid lipofuscin'.
